recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future Permission search-parameter updates, including any follow-up if FHIR-56877 becomes Applied/Published, should be made in HL7/data-access-policies unless Permission is reintroduced as an active core resource.
issue_request: FHIR-50222 is an Applied/Persuasive Security WG R6 change request asking to add a Permission search parameter for Permission.rule.limit.element so implementers can find permissions that remove particular elements from resources such as Patient.name or Patient.address.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3522 merged on 2025-07-03 while Permission was still an active core resource. Its commits added Permission-rule-limit-element to source/permission/bundle-Permission-search-params.xml and corrected the SearchParameter code to rule-limit-element with expression Permission.rule.limit.element.
additional_context: Permission was later removed from the active FHIR core build by commit 0e2a8a7f839d5e1a43787523daccf07d958362f3. Current core has no source/permission directory, no active Permission resource entry in source/fhir.ini, and narrative links point to the HL7 Data Access Policies IG. The current HL7/data-access-policies source at 7b340ee4c7b0ae4debbb5feb1270670539faa50f includes Permission-rule-limit-element. Later FHIR-56877 discusses clarifying limit.element and adding limit.path, but it is only Resolved - change required and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source change was made because the authoritative Permission source is now outside this checkout and already contains the seed search parameter.
